title: Slow Cooker Cream Cheese Chicken Chili
description: This effortless slow cooker cream cheese chicken chili recipe includes corn, black beans, tomatoes with green chiles, ranch dressing mix, and chili powder.
ingredients: 2 (5 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers (such as RO*TEL®), undrained
1 (8 ounce) package light cream cheese, cubed

steps.text: Place chicken in a slow cooker. Top with corn, black beans, diced tomatoes, ranch dressing mix, chili powder, cumin, and onion powder; stir to combine. Top with cream cheese. Cover slow cooker.
Cook on Low until chicken is no longer pink in the center and juices run clear, 6 to 8 hours. An instant-read thermometer inserted into centers should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
Transfer chicken to a bowl; shred with 2 forks. Stir shredded chicken into chili; serve.
